login.title: Sign in to AgentRe
login.description: Continue with your GitHub account. Both the desktop app and agentred daemon authorize through it.
login.userCodeLabel: Continue to device authorization after signing in
login.footer: By continuing, you agree to AgentRe's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

errors.oauth_state_invalid: The OAuth state has expired. Please start the sign-in again.
errors.oauth_exchange_failed: GitHub OAuth exchange failed. Retry later, or check the GitHub OAuth App settings.
errors.oauth_profile_failed: Could not fetch your GitHub profile.
errors.github_email_missing: Set a verified primary email in your GitHub settings, then try again.
errors.user_banned: This account is banned. Please contact an administrator.

entry.title: Enter the device code
entry.description: Your desktop app or terminal shows a 6-character code. Enter it here.
entry.hint: Case does not matter. The code never contains 0, O, 1 or I.
entry.footnote: No code on screen? Go back to the device and start authorization again.

errors.incomplete: Enter all six characters. The code never contains 0, O, 1 or I.
errors.invalid: That code does not exist or has already been used. Check the 6-character code shown on the device.

approve.title: Allow this device to access your AgentRe account?

risk.compute: This is a compute node. Once you approve it, it runs coding agents as you and can execute arbitrary code and commands under your account. Only approve devices you trust.
risk.neutral: Once you approve it, this device connects to your AgentRe account as you. Only approve devices you trust.

approve.verify: Check that this code matches exactly what the device shows
approve.capabilitiesLabel: What this device will be able to do

compute.title: Run coding agent tasks
compute.description: Run backends such as Claude Code and Codex on this device, and sync session results back to your account.

client.title: Connect as a client
client.description: Connect to AgentRe as you, exchange session messages and list your devices.

file_browse.title: Browse project files
file_browse.description: Read the listing and contents of the project directories you authorize.

capabilities.unknown: The console has no description for this capability yet. It is shown exactly as the device declared it, never hidden.

approve.expiryAnnounce: This authorization request expires in about {{minutes}} minutes
approve.expiryAnnounceSoon: This authorization request expires in less than a minute
approve.fineprint: You can revoke this device's access at any time under Console → Devices.
approve.actionError: That did not go through. Please try again.

success.title: Device authorized
success.body: You can close this page now and continue on the device.
success.manageDevices: Go to the console to manage devices

deniedScreen.title: Authorization denied
deniedScreen.body: This device will not receive any access. You can close this page now.

expiredScreen.title: Authorization request expired
expiredScreen.body: Device codes only stay valid for a short while. Go back to the device, start authorization again, then enter the new code.

manage.title: Devices
manage.empty: No devices yet. Devices you authorize will appear here.
manage.loadError: Could not load your devices. Please try again.
manage.revokeConfirmBody: This device can no longer refresh its credentials after you confirm. If it is offline right now, credentials already issued may still be accepted for their short validity window — revocation is not instant.
manage.revokeError: Could not revoke this device. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link may be broken, or the address is mistyped.
